mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.order_id, so.order_no, t1.curtain_id, c.name AS curtain_name, t1.structure_id, t1.material_id, t1.node_id, t1.node_name, pn.`group` AS node_group, t1.status, t1.master_id, tm.name AS master_name, t1.assistant_id, ta.name AS assistant_name, t1.note, t1.image_urls, t1.create_time, t1.update_time FROM zc_order_process_record t1 LEFT JOIN zc_sales_order so ON t1.order_id = so.id AND so.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_sales_order_curtain soc ON t1.curtain_id = soc.id AND soc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_curtain c ON soc.curtain_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN zc_process_node pn ON t1.node_id = pn.id AND pn.deleted = 0 AND pn.`group` = 1 LEFT JOIN zc_workshop_user tm ON t1.master_id = tm.id AND tm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_workshop_user ta ON t1.assistant_id = ta.id AND ta.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.order_id = #{orderId} AND t1.master_id = #{masterId} AND t1.curtain_id = #{curtainId} AND t1.structure_id = #{structureId} AND t1.material_id = #{materialId} AND t1.node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC
